nodes.label: FEA-Gated Modal Test Registration
nodes.rationale: The modal test list starts empty and is populated only when CH_ENABLE_MODULE_FEA is on, because every modal test (eigensolver, curved beam, cache reduced) exercises flexible-body models that only exist with the FEA module built. PardisoMKL is appended to the link libraries only when that module is enabled, so the modal tests can use the direct sparse solver when available without making it a hard dependency.

edges.source_location: Both append Chrono_pardisomkl under the identical CH_ENABLE_MODULE_PARDISO_MKL guard
